description: Shields and prevention - stop the damage before it lands.

nodes.name: Unbreakable Will
nodes.description: Reduces the duration of Stun effects against you by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Reduces the duration of Stun, Fear, and Silence effects done to you by an additional 6%-30%.' Fear and silence do not exist; is_stun is this engine's only incapacitate. stun_duration_reduction_pct is a FRACTION and floors a stun at 1 turn. The outgoing version also carried magic_damage_taken_pct, which is Spell Warding's job in the Holy tree.

nodes.name: Twin Disciplines
nodes.description: Increases your spell damage and healing by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Increases the damage and healing done by your instant spells by 1%-5%.' Built with both halves - there is no instant/cast distinction to restrict it to. The outgoing version was cost cuts on Renew and Power Word: Shield, which is Mental Agility's and Soul Warding's job. Both keys are FRACTIONS.

nodes.name: Silent Resolve
nodes.description: Reduces the threat you generate by 7% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Reduces the threat generated by your Holy and Discipline spells by 7%-20% and reduces the chance your helpful spells and damage over time effects will be dispelled.' The threat half is built - there is no per-school threat key, only the global threat_generation_pct, which is a FRACTION. Dispel resistance does not exist.

nodes.name: Meditation
nodes.description: Restores 8 mana every 5 seconds per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Allows 17%/33%/50% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting.' DEPARTURE - there are no cast times, so regeneration never stops and there is nothing to restore. Delivered as flat regeneration, which is the same mana by a different route. Kept from the outgoing tree, which also granted flat spirit - removed, since Enlightenment is the Spirit talent.

nodes.name: Improved Inner Fire
nodes.description: Increases the effect of your Inner Fire by 15% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Increases the effect of your Inner Fire spell by 15%/30%/45%, and increases the total number of charges by 12.' The potency half is built verbatim. Charges do not exist - there is no charge system. ability_<id>_potency scales the ability's own stat_mods. Kept from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Inner Focus
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of your abilities by 5% and increases your spell critical chance by 3%.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'When activated, reduces the mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is a damage or healing spell.' DEPARTURE - there is no ability to unlock, and nothing consumes a buff on use, so 'your next spell' cannot be expressed. Delivered as a permanent but far smaller version of both clauses. all_ability_cost_pct is a FRACTION where POSITIVE IS A REDUCTION. The outgoing version was a proc with an empty effects dict. It is Aspiration's cooldown target in the real tree.

nodes.name: Improved Power Word: Fortitude
nodes.description: Increases the effect of your Power Word: Fortitude by 15% per rank and your Stamina by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, built with both halves: 'Increases the effect of your Power Word: Fortitude and Prayer of Fortitude spells by 15%/30%, and increases your total Stamina by 2%/4%.' Prayer of Fortitude does not exist. The outgoing tree had this as 'Divine Spirit' with a 0.5 potency value, which is neither the right talent nor a plausible magnitude. stamina_pct is PERCENTAGE POINTS.

nodes.name: Improved Power Word: Shield
nodes.description: Increases the damage absorbed by your Power Word: Shield by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Increases the damage absorbed by your Power Word: Shield by 5%/10%/15%.' Built verbatim; the outgoing version was 10% per rank, reaching 30%. It is Soul Warding's prerequisite in the real tree, preserved below.

nodes.name: Martyrdom
nodes.description: Being struck steadies you, increasing your spell critical chance by 10% for 2 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, NEW to our tree: 'Gives you a 50%/100% chance to gain the Focused Casting effect that lasts for 6 sec after being the victim of a melee or ranged critical strike, reducing the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting by 100%.' DEPARTURE - there is no on-crit-TAKEN trigger and no pushback to reduce. on_damage_taken with icd 2 is the nearest real moment, and the payoff is the thing unimpeded casting gives a Discipline priest: better spells. 6 seconds is 2 turns.

nodes.name: Absolution
nodes.description: Reduces the mana cost of your Dispel Magic and Abolish Disease by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Reduces the mana cost of your Dispel Magic, Cure Disease, Abolish Disease and Mass Dispel spells by 5%/10%/15%.' Built verbatim for the two that exist. _cost_pct is a FRACTION where POSITIVE IS A REDUCTION. Kept from the outgoing tree, which used the FLAT _cost key on Abolish Disease only.

nodes.name: Reflective Shield
nodes.description: Your shield lashes back, dealing damage to those who strike you.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Causes 23%/45% of the damage you absorb with Power Word: Shield to reflect back at the attacker. This damage causes no threat.' DEPARTURE - nothing reports how much an absorb shield soaked, and none of the three payloads that read a triggering amount (bonus_pct, leech_pct, smart heals) reflects. damage_flat 35 typed as Holy is a fixed return, with icd 1 holding it to once a turn. The no-threat clause has no key. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree, which also attached magic_damage_taken_pct that this talent does not have.

nodes.name: Mental Agility
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of your abilities by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Reduces the mana cost of your instant cast spells by 3%/7%/10%.' There is no instant/cast distinction, so it covers everything at the real per-rank value. Stacks with Inner Focus. The outgoing version was flat cost cuts on two named spells.

nodes.name: Mental Strength
nodes.description: Increases your Intellect by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, NEW to our tree: 'Increases your total Intellect by 3%-15%.' intellect_pct is PERCENTAGE POINTS, read off `bonuses` and divided by 100. It is Power Infusion's prerequisite in the real tree, preserved below.

nodes.name: Soul Warding
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Power Word: Shield by 1 turn and its cost by 15%.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, NEW to our tree, built verbatim: 'Reduces the cooldown of your Power Word: Shield ability by 4 sec, and reduces the mana cost by 15%.' 4 seconds is 1 turn. The real talent requires Improved Power Word: Shield, which connected_to reproduces.

nodes.name: Focused Power
nodes.description: Increases your spell damage and healing by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3: 'Increases damage and healing done by your spells by 2%/4%. In addition, your Mass Dispel cast time is reduced by 0.5/1 sec.' The throughput half is built verbatim; Mass Dispel does not exist and there are no cast times. The outgoing version was per-ability healing on Penance, which is Searing Light's territory.

nodes.name: Enlightenment
nodes.description: Increases your Spirit by 2% per rank and your haste by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3, built verbatim with both halves: 'Increases your total Spirit by 2%-6% and increases your spell haste by 2%-6%.' The outgoing version granted FLAT intellect and spirit, which is neither clause. spirit_pct and haste are both PERCENTAGE POINTS.

nodes.name: Focused Will
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical chance by 1% per rank and reduces damage taken by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, NEW to our tree: 'Increases your spell critical effect chance by 1%-3%, and after taking a critical hit you gain the Focused Will effect, reducing damage taken.' The crit half is verbatim. DEPARTURE on the second - there is no on-crit-TAKEN trigger - so the mitigation is unconditional at a small value. damage_taken_pct is read RAW on both sides.

nodes.name: Renewed Hope
nodes.description: Increases the critical chance of your Heal and Penance by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4: 'Increases the critical effect chance of your Flash Heal, Greater Heal and Penance (Heal) spells by 2%/4% on targets afflicted by Weakened Soul.' Flash Heal and Greater Heal do not exist; priest_heal stands in. The Weakened Soul condition cannot be read - nothing reads a debuff on the target - so the crit is unconditional. ability_<id>_crit is PERCENTAGE POINTS. This talent was in our HOLY tree; the real game puts it in Discipline.

nodes.name: Power Infusion
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 5% and reduces your ability costs by 5%.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4: 'Infuses the target with power, increasing spell casting speed by 20% and reducing the mana cost of all spells by 20%. Lasts 15 sec.' DEPARTURE - there is no ability to unlock and a talent effect can never reach an ally, so both real clauses apply to the priest permanently at a quarter of the magnitude. The real talent requires Mental Strength, which connected_to reproduces. The outgoing version was a proc with an empty effects dict.

nodes.name: Rapture
nodes.description: Being struck restores 150 mana.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4: 'When your Power Word: Shield is completely absorbed or dispelled you are instantly energized with 1.5%-2.5% of your total mana.' DEPARTURE - there is no trigger for an absorb being consumed, for an effect EXPIRING, or for a dispel. on_damage_taken is the nearest real moment, since that is what consumes a shield. grant_resource takes a FLAT amount with no pct_max, so 150 is fixed. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree, which also granted max_mana_pct that this talent does not have.

nodes.name: Improved Flash Heal
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of your Heal by 5% per rank and increases its critical chance by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4: 'Reduces the mana cost of your Flash Heal by 5%-15%, and increases the critical effect chance of your Flash Heal by 10% on friendly targets below 50% health.' Flash Heal does not exist, so both clauses land on priest_heal. The health condition cannot be read for a FRIENDLY target - low_health_damage_pct reads an enemy and low_health_healing_pct exists but is not ability-scoped - so the crit is unconditional and smaller. Kept from the outgoing tree, which was a proc with a flat cost cut.

nodes.name: Aspiration
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Penance and Power Word: Shield by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4: 'Reduces the cooldown of your Inner Focus, Power Infusion, Pain Suppression and Penance spells by 10%/20%.' Of the four, only Penance is an ability here - the other three are talents in our build - so Power Word: Shield is added as the tree's other real cooldown. Stacks with Soul Warding; talented_cooldown clamps at 1 turn. Kept from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Divine Aegis
nodes.description: Your critical heals leave a protective shield on you.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Critical heals create a protective shield on the target, absorbing 10%-30% of the amount healed. Lasts 12 sec.' Built as a real absorb shield - `absorb` IS a valid StatusEffect field and a buff can raise one. Sizing it from the heal is not possible (none of the amount-reading payloads creates a shield), so 200 is flat. on_target is False because a talent-sourced effect cannot be aimed at the heal's recipient. 12 seconds is 4 turns. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Pain Suppression
nodes.description: While below half health, reduces all damage you take by 20%.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Instantly reduces a friendly target's threat by 5%, reduces all damage taken by 40% and increases resistance to Dispel mechanics.' DEPARTURE - no ability to unlock, and a talent effect can never reach an ally, so the protection is the priest's own and conditional on being in trouble, which is when the real spell is cast. low_health_damage_reduction_pct reads the ACTOR's health and defaults to a 50% threshold - low_health_threshold_pct is NOT authored, where the outgoing version did author it.

nodes.name: Borrowed Time
nodes.description: Casting Power Word: Shield grants 25% haste for 2 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Grants 5%-25% spell haste for your next spell after casting Power Word: Shield, and increases the amount absorbed by your Power Word: Shield by 8%-40%.' The haste half is built with the real 25% at full rank and the real ability_filter. 'Your next spell' becomes a 2-turn window - nothing consumes a buff on use. The absorb half is left to Improved Power Word: Shield rather than doubled here. Ranked by chance, since a proc's payload does not scale with points. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Grace
nodes.description: Your Heal and Penance bless the target, increasing healing they receive.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Your Flash Heal, Greater Heal, and Penance spells have a 100% chance to bless the target with Grace, increasing all healing received by 3%/6%.' Built on on_heal_cast with the real 6% at full rank. on_target is False because a talent-sourced effect cannot be aimed at the heal's recipient, so the priest carries the Grace rather than the target - a real departure, recorded. Inside a status effect healing_taken_pct is PERCENTAGE POINTS, the opposite convention to the same key as a talent effect. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Penance
nodes.description: Teaches Penance, a volley of holy light that wounds an enemy or mends an ally.
nodes._source: WotLK row 10, the capstone, kept - the ONLY unlock for priest_penance, which is requires_talent.

nodes.name: Exalted Grace
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike damage of your spells by 20% per rank.
nodes._source: Authored 6 Nov. Kyle: 'all caster classes should have a 5 point talent that increases their spell crit damage by 100%.' Mirrors priest_shadow's Shadow Power and shaman_elemental's Elemental Fury, both of which are WoW-accurate at 5 x 20%. Placed on tier 4 beside the existing tier-4 block; connected_to is cosmetic (it draws the edge), spending is gated by tier_requirements.
